profile.summary: RNAfold predicts RNA secondary structure and thermodynamic ensemble quantities within the ViennaRNA package.
profile.summary_source_locator: README.md: package capabilities, executable programs, Energy Parameters and License

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: RNAfold predicts RNA secondary structure and thermodynamic ensemble quantities within the ViennaRNA package. Energy-based RNA secondary-structure calculation; minimum-free-energy and partition-function modes are distinct outputs. The documented inputs are RNA nucleotide sequence with selected thermodynamic settings and supported constraints. The output consists of predicted secondary structure and, in ensemble mode, partition-function-derived probabilities.
sections.source_locator: README.md: package capabilities, executable programs, Energy Parameters and License

sections.title: Versions and reproducibility
sections.body: RNAfold within ViennaRNA; software and energy-parameter set must be pinned. Implementation and memory dependent; the package README gives an upper representational length with an explicit large-memory caveat.

strengths.text: Provides an interpretable thermodynamic reference for comparison with learned RNA structure methods.
strengths.source_locator: README.md: package capabilities, executable programs, Energy Parameters and License

limitations.text: The package includes multiple programs with different tasks. RNAfold secondary structure must not be presented as three-dimensional RNA folding. Sequence length is constrained by memory and algorithmic cost.
limitations.source_locator: README.md: package capabilities, executable programs, Energy Parameters and License
